title: refactor(objectql): ObjectQL#update's body moves into its own facet, engine-update.ts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9CjeUv15kvivj1rNCQgSB9h)_
> **⏸ This PR waits for a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval (`os-zhuang` or `hotlong`) before it lands.** It is 4,523 changed lines, over the 3,000-line human-merge rule, because it is a mechanical move of one 2,106-line method body (generated by the codemod, proven byte-for-byte reversible); and it touches a Tier H path (`docs/adr/0020-state-machine-converge-and-enforce.md`, one link re-pointed). The seat will not mark it ready or queue it before that approval.

Refs #30020
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Part B of #30020 §5 item E6 (`update`): the move itself. Part A, the codemod capability it needs (R11, start the facet a section anchor names), landed as #32018 (`eb66b74f`); this branch was restarted from `main` after it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：用引擎拆分脚本（`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members update --write`）把 `ObjectQL#update` 的 2,106 行方法体从 `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 原样搬进新 facet `engine-update.ts`（分节表早已为它登记的模块名），类上保留签名和文档注释的一行转调桩；另有 5 处随搬移而必改的指针（门禁登记行、普查表行、ADR 链接、一个对等测试的文件清单、changeset）。
- 为什么改：#30020 拆分 `engine.ts`，E6 是 `update` 这一项；A 部分（#32018）让脚本能新建该 facet，本 PR 是实际搬移。
- 风险与回滚：纯机械搬移，语句和顺序不变；`@objectstack/objectql` 发布的 `.d.ts` 与基线逐字节相同，objectql 全套 583 文件 / 12016 测试全绿，撤销证明 `--members --verify --base eb66b74f` 逐字节重建基线。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`engine.ts` 中 `update` 的转调桩、`engine-update.ts` 文件头注释和 `UpdateHost` 接口，然后是下方 “Forced edits” 表里的 5 处小改动。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members --verify --base eb66b74f`，预期打印 `undoing the moves does rebuild the base engine.ts and its modules byte-for-byte`；再跑 `pnpm check:facade-delegation-only`，预期通过且登记例外从 7 降到 6。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 超过 3,000 行并触及 Tier H 路径（docs/adr），需 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准后才能落地；席位不会在批准前标记 ready 或入队。

## What changes

Generated, not hand-edited (`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --members update --write` on `eb66b74f`):

- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` (8692 → 6597 lines): the body of `update` leaves; the method stays on the class as a one-call stub (`return UpdateFacet.update.call(updateHost.of(this), …)`) with its signature and its public docblock. The facet import, the `updateHost` entry in the hosts import and its install call in the class's static block are added in the places the first pass puts them (section order; sorted).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts` (new, 2253 lines): `UpdateFacet.update`, the body exactly as it stood (not re-indented, not formatted), and `UpdateHost`, the members it reads. Bare `this` (the body hands the engine itself on) reads `this.facade` (R1); its one static read (the home-amount organization lookup) goes through the `ObjectQLStatics` forwarder the other facets use (R10).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-facet-hosts.ts` (+2): the `UpdateHost` type import and `updateHost`.

### Forced edits (each one is the move's consequence, nothing else)

| File | Edit | Why it is forced |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` | delete the `ObjectQL.update` row (exceptions 7 → 6) | `check:facade-delegation-only` refuses a registry row for a member that now delegates |
| `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` | register row `engine.ts#update` → `engine-update.ts#update` (4 sites, rows 19, 20) | regenerated with `node scripts/check-system-context-census.mjs --write`; the census refuses a stale row |
| `packages/objectql/src/validate-preview-parent.test.ts` (**test edit**) | the parity test (#22474 (f)) reads `engine-update.ts` too; header comment and the E5 note updated | the test reads the write-side `evaluateValidationRules` calls from source; `update`'s call moved file, so without this the parity check would silently read one write fewer |
| `docs/adr/0020-state-machine-converge-and-enforce.md:52` (**Tier H**) | one link's text and href: `engine.ts#validateRecord` → `engine-update.ts#validateRecord`; the sentence is unchanged | `check:adr-symbol-anchors` anchors the cited `validateRecord(schema, hookContext.input.data, 'update')` call, which now lives in `engine-update.ts` (seat ruling A, claim amendment 6755928473) |
| `.changeset/30020-objectql-update-facet.md` | `'@objectstack/objectql': patch` | the published JS and source maps change; the `.d.ts` does not |

No new public key, error code, route or export. `index.ts` re-exports nothing from `engine-update.ts`. `packages/spec/liveness/validation.json` cites `engine.ts#update` as evidence; the stub keeps that name resolving, so `packages/spec/**` is untouched.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` (under `os-verify-lock`): base `8031f49d` 583 files / 12016 tests pass; head `45207d62` **583 files / 12016 tests pass** (VERDICT command-exit 0). Same counts; the only test edit is the parity file list above.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (under `os-verify-lock`, head `45207d62`): **445 files passed, 3 skipped (448); 3689 tests passed, 42 skipped (3731)**, VERDICT command-exit 0. `update` is on every edit path, so the battery runs the move end to end.
- Codemod: `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test` 250 cases in 15 batteries pass; undo proof `--members --verify --base eb66b74f` exit 0 (`engine.ts 8692 -> 6597 lines; undoing the moves does rebuild the base engine.ts and its modules byte-for-byte`).
- Lint: `eslint --no-inline-config` (the root `pnpm lint` form) on the four changed `.ts` files: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Public surface unchanged.** After a full `pnpm build` (VERDICT exit 0) the emitted `@objectstack/objectql` declarations are byte-identical to base: `index.d.ts` (sha256 `dfe637cdc3d9…`), `core.d.ts` (`d324857848b0…`), `util-C-DLCRzI.d.ts` (`d1dd7de44fb0…`).
- **Behaviour unchanged.** The same statements run in the same order; the stub keeps an instance spy and a subclass override reaching the same method (the host's methods are closures that call the engine at call time).
- **Size.** 8 files, +2344 / −2179 = 4,523 changed lines; 4,492 of them are the generated move (`engine.ts`, `engine-update.ts`, `engine-facet-hosts.ts`). There is no smaller split: the body cannot move in halves.
- Swallow-census controls stay green with no re-point (`check:swallow-census-controls` in the sweep below).

## Verification
